environment: Node 22.22.1, Astro build, headless Linux; temporary files under src/content/news/ removed after the test
precheck: astro.config.mjs newsWidgetsValidation: readdir(NEWS_DIR, { recursive: true, withFileTypes: true }) filtered to *.md

cases.name: nested unclosed highlight container
cases.injection: :::highlight[未闭合] without closing ::: at file end
cases.outputExcerpt: [news-widgets] /home/photon/workspace/nlp-home-008/src/content/news/__t043_nested/probe.md:7 highlight 容器未闭合：缺少结尾 `:::`。
cases.note: The nested path is reached by the recursive precheck, proving parity with the glob('**/*.md') loader.

cases.name: nested non-lowercase BibTeX fence
cases.outputExcerpt: [news-widgets] /home/photon/workspace/nlp-home-008/src/content/news/__t043_nested/probe.md:7 代码块语言标记 "BibTeX" 无效：BibTeX 引用块必须使用小写 `bibtex`（如 ```bibtex）。

cases.name: nested unknown container (soft warning probe)
cases.outputExcerpt: [news-widgets] ...:7 未知容器指令 :::foo 已展开为普通内容。 then [ERROR] [build] Caught error rendering /news/__t043_nested/probe: TypeError: Missing parameter: id
cases.note: The widget layer emits only a controlled warning; the build exits 1 later because src/pages/news/[id].astro is a single-segment dynamic route and cannot publish a nested news id such as __t043_nested/probe. Nested news directories are walked by the precheck to match the loader, but are not a supported publishing layout. Soft-warning behavior is therefore verified separately with a top-level file.

cases.name: top-level unknown container (soft warning behavior)
cases.outputExcerpt: [news-widgets] /home/photon/workspace/nlp-home-008/src/content/news/__t043-soft.md:7 未知容器指令 :::foo 已展开为普通内容。
cases.note: Build succeeds, warning appears exactly once, includes file and line.

cleanup: Both temporary news files and the __t043_nested directory were deleted; the subsequent final build is green.
